fields.Name: Party Customer Roster
fields.UserQuestion: Which organizations and people have placed orders, how many, and when did they last order?
fields.Description: Orders' contribution to the Party Signals roster: one row per bill-to organization and one per bill-to person over non-voided orders, with the count and the latest order date. Read by the shared party pickers so a picker can offer customers before the rest of the directory. [signal: order|orders]
fields.TechnicalDescription: Party Signals contract columns PartyKind ('organization' | 'person'), PartyID, Count, LastActivityAt. Two grouped selects over __mj_BizAppsOrders.vwOrderHeaders WHERE Status <> 'Voided', unioned; bill-to is the customer (D65), ship-to is not. No parameters and no template — the picker filters and ranks the rows.
